# Need cash: what does a 401(k) loan, a withdrawal or an outside loan really cost?

> Free 401(k) loan vs withdrawal calculator: the true cost of each, with tax, penalty, lost growth and the job-loss risk, next to an outside loan. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/401k-loan-vs-withdrawal-calculator/)
